spec_seeds.overview: Replace the raw-mode CodeEditor's overlay edit mechanism with a design-matched edit/preview toggle. An 'editing' boolean (owned by BodyEditor) gates the render so the code area shows EITHER a plain textarea (editing) OR the highlighted pre (preview) — never both mounted — and the JSON tokenizer runs once on the switch-to-preview transition instead of on every keystroke. A visible toggle button plus click-to-edit (caret placed at the clicked character) drive the state, shedding the transparent-textarea/absolute-pre stack, the textarea->pre scroll sync, the per-keystroke debounce, and the colored-during-edit snapshot.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The CodeEditor shall not declare a textarea-to-pre scroll-synchronisation handler.
The CodeEditor shall not declare a debounced colored-snapshot state for the editing surface.
The BodyEditor shall provide an edit/preview toggle control carrying a stable data-testid.
IF the raw text is not valid JSON, THEN the CodeEditor shall render it as a single plain segment without throwing.
The CodeEditor shall reuse the existing jsonTokens compose library unchanged for syntax highlighting.
WHEN the active request tab switches, the CodeEditor shall reset the code-area scroll offset and return to preview.
WHILE the none or urlencoded body mode is active, the BodyEditor shall behave identically to its pre-change behavior.
The CodeEditor shall insert all highlighted token text as escaped children and never via innerHTML.
The CodeEditor shall keep the gutter, the preview, and the edit textarea rows on one shared line-box height in both states.
WHILE editing is false the CodeEditor shall render only the preview pre, and while editing is true it shall render only the plain textarea, never mounting both together.
The CodeEditor shall expose only the currently visible layer data-testid, namely body-pre in preview and the textarea in edit.
WHEN the user clicks the preview, the CodeEditor shall enter edit mode and place the caret at the clicked character.
IF a preview click lands past the end of a line or below the text, THEN the CodeEditor shall clamp the caret to the nearest character.
WHEN the CodeEditor switches to preview, the system shall run the tokenizer exactly once for that transition rather than per keystroke.
WHILE editing is true, the textarea shall disable spellcheck, disable resize, keep the Tab key native, and wrap with white-space pre giving horizontal scroll and no soft-wrap.
WHEN the textarea loses focus or the toggle control is activated, the CodeEditor shall leave edit mode and return to preview.
WHEN a request raw code area first mounts, the CodeEditor shall start in preview.
WHERE the user operates by keyboard, the preview shall be focusable and Enter or Space shall enter edit mode.
WHILE either layer is visible, the gutter shall track that layer within one scroll container.
The documentation shall describe the CodeEditor as an edit/preview toggle whose highlighting runs on switch-to-preview.
The renderer shall pass type-check and lint after the change.
The CodeEditor stylesheet shall not use an em-based gutter row height.
The CodeEditor component shall not use inline element styles for the toggle states.

ac_subsection_na.ci_pipeline: No CI/pipeline change — pure renderer component change covered by existing vitest + playwright CT jobs
ac_subsection_na.hooks_gates: No new git hooks, pre-commit, or CI gates introduced

constraints.content: Editing is ephemeral UI state owned by BodyEditor local component state, never a tabsStore domain field (raw text still round-trips through updateActiveSpec unchanged)
Commits follow Conventional Commits and include the Co-Authored-By: Claude attribution trailer
compose()'s JSON.parse pre-validation is the malformed-JSON degrade-to-plain detector — it must not be removed or bypassed

affected_areas.impact: Add editing/onEditingChange props; conditionally mount textarea XOR pre; tokenize once on switch-to-preview; add click-to-edit (caret-at-click, clamped) + preview focus/Enter entry; remove scroll-sync handler, debounced re-tokenize effect, colored-during-edit snapshot; CSS drops absolute-overlay stacking, keeps --code-line-h line-box + horizontal-scroll on the single visible layer
Own the editing boolean (default preview; reset to preview on activeTabId change); render the edit/preview toggle button in the toolbar and wire it + pass editing/onEditingChange to CodeEditor
Split the AC-12/13/21 line-box co-read into edit-state and preview-state reads; add toggle/click-to-edit/caret/entry coverage; drop the live/debounced (018 AC-23) colored-during-edit assertions
Cover the toggle button + editing-state ownership + reset-to-preview-on-tab-switch; adjust testid assertions to only-visible-layer
Update the CodeEditor molecule description from three-layer overlay to edit/preview toggle (editing prop, tokenize-on-preview)

out_of_scope.content: Any third-party editor engine (CodeMirror, Monaco, etc.) — the edit surface stays a native textarea
Auto-indent, bracket/quote auto-close, multi-cursor, find/replace, and paste-and-format
Syntax highlighting while typing — plain-while-editing is the accepted tradeoff (colored only in preview)
Changing the jsonTokens compose library or its token vocabulary — reused byte-unchanged
Any other CodeEditor consumer (response-body viewer, GraphQL variables) — none exists; BodyEditor is the sole consumer

open_questions.content: Caret-at-click implementation: whether native textarea focus already lands the caret at the clicked character, or a click-coordinate to character-offset mapping is required (research runtime-probe pinned; either satisfies AC-12).
Whether textarea scroll/selection must be retained across an edit->preview->edit round trip within the same tab, or may reset (research open uncertainty).

risks.risk: Line-box (20.625px) alignment must hold in BOTH toggle states; gutter must track the visible layer in one scroll container; caret-at-click mapping correctness; scroll-position preservation across toggle.
Conditional-mount does not preserve textarea scroll/selection across a toggle; display:none/unmount loses scrollTop and focus() can re-clobber it
risks.mitigation: Decide scroll retention in /plan (Q-2); if required, capture scrollTop/selection at switch and restore after mount with focus({preventScroll:true})

risks.risk: CodeEditor/BodyEditor Playwright CT cannot mount in the local harness (pre-existing break)
risks.mitigation: Verify statically + live-verify per 018; leave test:ct Done-When UNVERIFIED rather than burning repair rounds; reproduce tokens.css import + data-mstyle + production className scope in fixtures

risks.risk: CT AC-12/13/21 line-box co-read of pre+textarea in one state breaks once only one layer mounts at a time
risks.mitigation: Split the line-box assertion into an edit-state read (textarea) and a preview-state read (pre); both must equal the shared line-box height

risks.risk: Line-box row height could drift between the edit and preview states if the single mounted layer inherits different metrics
risks.mitigation: Both states bind the same --code-line-h var + identical font/padding/box-sizing; DOM-verify equal row heights per state
